instruction.text: Now you are facing towards the opening. Turn right. Move forward till a black table. Turn slightly right. Move forward near the steps. Turn slightly right. Move forward near the pole. Turn left. Move forward behind the sofa. You can see an opening in front of you. Go out of the opening. Move forward beside the chair. Turn left. Move forward in between the sofa to the left and chair to the right. Turn slightly right. Move forward to the swimming pool. You have reached your destination.
